name: Zettai Ryouiki ☆ Sex Royale!! ~Mujintou Okashiai Battle~
original_name: ぜったい猟域☆セックス・ロワイアル!! ～無人島犯し合いバトル～
source:
The world has come to placing women above men due to females having higher physical and spiritual ability. In order to escape the oppression, most males decide to run away from the real world and indulge themselves in the 2D world.

The protagonist, besides having a sadistic mother and a masochistic father, is just a normal student. Suddenly one day, he and 7 other female students are taken to a uninhabited island in order to participate in "Sex Royale".

"Sex Royale" is a game where there are 2 teams, boy and girls, each team try to violate the other to gain points. And thus, on a deserted island, an unprecedented battle begins.

[Translated from [url=http://softhouse-seal.com/product/g-003/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
